outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: Away from their native regions, they have become established in the Americas, Australia and New Zealand as weeds.

outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: Dandelion root is a registered drug in Canada, sold as a diuretic.

outgoing.name: Coffee
outgoing.excerpt: Ground roasted dandelion root can be used as a coffee substitute.

outgoing.name: Egg (food)
outgoing.excerpt: Dandelion salad is often accompanied with hard boiled eggs.

outgoing.name: Soup

outgoing.name: Vitamin C
outgoing.excerpt: The leaves are high in vitamin A, vitamin C and iron, carrying more iron and calcium than spinach.

outgoing.name: Wine
outgoing.excerpt: Dandelion flowers can be used to make dandelion wine.
